See my now page for my latest updates.

Archived on 2026-05-10

Work

I’m two weeks into a new job! Now I can say that I was interviewing and get an offer during the craziness of the job market of 2025.

Coffee

I was forced to buy a new coffee bean this week. Trader Joe’s has been picked through and I can’t get my usual medium roast. I want to taste this one next to the bean I normally get. I think I like the new one more because it has a more rounded out flavor profile. But I’m not 100% sure.
